analysis.rationale: Exact pixel-perfect reproduction of the target (PSNR=inf, CI=10/10) and of four independent support pairs with a single deterministic global step. Compression/blur/noise ruled out by block_boundary=0.996, spectral_slope_ratio=1.0002, sigma=0.12 and zero residual after applying the candidate. Brightness_mean_shift=+7.9 and variance_ratio=1.1728 are explained by HSV desaturation collapsing RGB toward V, not by separate brightness/contrast/gamma steps.
